chain_words.nuance: difficulty caused by a lack of comfort or resources
a state of lacking what is required to live comfortably
a general state of having little money or property
complete lack of the means to survive
extreme and desperate lack of money

explanation: These words all describe a lack of money or resources, from everyday hardship to desperate and extreme deprivation.

usage_notes.difference: 'Poverty' describes having little money or property; 'destitution' describes having no means at all to meet basic needs.
